;This dataset is freely available with one restriction:
;If you use the data or some product based on the data in a published paper refer to
;Finsterle, W., Montillet, J.P., Schmutz, W. et al. The total solar irradiance during the recent solar minimum period measured by SOHO/VIRGO. 
;Sci Rep 11, 7835 (2021). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-021-87108-y
;and acknowledge receipt of the updated dataset (mention version used) "of the VIRGO Experiment 
;on the cooperative ESA/NASA Mission SOHO from VIRGO Team through PMOD/WRC, Davos, Switzerland" 
;The SOHO/VIRGO data are available at:
;ftp://ftp.pmodwrc.ch/pub/data/irradiance/virgo/TSI/ and the SOHO archives at ESA and NASA
;org = original data degradation corrected  in VIRGO scale (WRR)
;new = originale data rescaled in SI [see discussion -- Table 2 (Finsterle et al., 2021)]
;Description of columns:
;1st col: UTC time
;2nd col: TAI
;3rd col: TSI VIRGO A degradation corrected (W m^-2) [original VIRGO scale, calibrated against the World Radiometric Reference (WRR)]
;4th col: TSI VIRGO A+B - Fused (W m-2) [original VIRGO scale, calibrated against the World Radiometric Reference (WRR)]
;5th col: Uncertainty of fused VIRGO A+B series
;6th col: TSI VIRGO A degradation corrected (W m^-2) [new VIRGO scale, traceable against SI]
;7th col: TSI VIRGO A+B - Fused (W m-^2) [new VIRGO scale, traceable against SI]
;the original and new VIRGO scales differ by 0.34% (https://doi.org/10.1088/0026-1394/49/2/S34), resulting in an offset of ~ -4.6 W m^-2
;Col 4,5,7,8 contain the daily average of the corresponding day.
